obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Primary text, filled pill buttons, hairline borders on light surfaces, active icons

bone.$description: Bone — Page canvas, card surfaces, text on dark buttons, image overlays

mist.$description: Mist — Elevated surface wash, subtle card backgrounds, section dividers

fog.$description: Fog — Hairline dividers between feed cards, faint table borders

ash.$description: Ash — Subtle structural borders, disabled state outlines

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary text, supporting metadata, icon strokes

steel.$description: Steel — Muted helper text, timestamps, tertiary captions

lyon.$description: Whisper-weight display serif for editorial headlines, pull quotes, and section titles — the anti-convention weight 100 creates authority through restraint rather than volume, making the brand feel printed rather than web-native

suisse.$description: Neo-grotesque sans for body copy, navigation, button labels, tags, and utility UI — 400 reads body, 500 carries button labels and nav, 600 anchors subheadings; the wide weight range lets this one family run the entire interface without switching faces
